description: This file defines the OrCriteriaImpl class, which implements the Criteria interface to represent a logical OR operation over multiple criteria within a query framework. It includes methods for accepting visitors, equality checks, and hashing.

classes.name: OrCriteriaImpl
classes.description: Implements a criteria that performs a logical OR over multiple sub-criteria.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a CriteriaVisitor and applies the visitOr method to the stream of criteria results.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the internal list of criteria.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on the criteria list.
